requirement: Secure signup and password login
finding: Supabase-backed signup, email confirmation, login, refresh and logout. Selected auth tests passed.

requirement: Login with Google (OAuth 2.0)
finding: Google OAuth/PKCE client flow and callback handling exist. Live provider login was not exercised in this audit.

requirement: Create a delivery request integrated with the system
finding: Fixed: database-backed booking API and real web/mobile booking forms; initial history and event captured atomically. 13 operational integration tests cover the shared flow.

requirement: Estimate delivery fee before confirmation
finding: Server quote uses shared persisted LKR pricing. Changing pricing affects the next quote.

requirement: Real-time status tracking through delivery/failure stages
finding: Web tracking consumes database status through WebSockets/polling. New bookings now persist to that database.

requirement: View customer delivery history
finding: Owner-scoped database history now includes new persistent bookings.

requirement: Download a delivery receipt
finding: Owner-scoped HTML receipt download and browser Print / Save as PDF exist.

requirement: Mobile-friendly public tracking by tracking number
finding: Responsive public web tracking and API polling are implemented. The native tracking screen is now connected to the same public tracking API.

requirement: Merchant registration with staff/admin approval
finding: Unified business registration, email confirmation and staff approval are implemented. Portal sign-in uses the managed session flow.

requirement: Create delivery orders through secured partner API
finding: API-key authentication, hashed keys, approval checks, rate limits, validated inputs and transactional database inserts exist. API keys satisfy the assignment alternative to client credentials.

requirement: Merchant dashboard showing orders and delivery states
finding: Merchant-scoped order dashboard uses the shared authenticated API client, including refresh/session handling.

requirement: Receive webhooks for courier parcel status changes
finding: Fixed: status-event trigger includes merchantId, parcel data and stable eventId. Webhook worker consumes the same contract; durable delivery/retry tested with mocked HTTP.

requirement: Courier login and authentication
finding: Shared auth verifies server profile and courier role; courier operational endpoints restrict roles.

requirement: View assigned deliveries
finding: Production courier jobs come from the database. Seeded data is no longer a runtime fallback.

requirement: Restrict assigned-delivery list to the day
finding: Fixed: courier jobs query uses the current Asia/Colombo assignment date.

requirement: Update parcel stages with delivery notes
finding: Production courier updates validate assignment and transition, then persist history and status.

requirement: Upload delivery proof
finding: Web file capture and native camera upload use the proof API; delivery requires an uploaded proof record.

requirement: Record a failed delivery with a reason
finding: Failure reason is required and persisted in the parcel timeline.

requirement: View unassigned parcels
finding: Dispatch board uses database parcels; errors are displayed instead of fabricated records.

requirement: Assign parcels to couriers
finding: Assignment runs in a database function with courier/parcel locks and capacity enforcement.

requirement: Monitor courier active-delivery workloads
finding: Database workload aggregation is connected to the dispatcher board.

requirement: Manage users
finding: Fixed: admin can activate/deactivate accounts and update names/contact fields through an admin-only endpoint. Self-deactivation and last-admin safeguards are enforced. UI includes activation controls.

requirement: Manage/approve merchants
finding: Merchant registration/approval remains in the unified managed-auth workflow.

requirement: Manage persistent delivery zones
finding: Fixed: zone edits persist in PostgreSQL. Disabled zones cannot be quoted. Configuration reloads from the database.

requirement: Manage pricing used by bookings
finding: Fixed: customer and merchant calculations share persisted pricing. Default quotes use global rates; explicit zones use zone rates. No client price is trusted.

requirement: Reports: deliveries/day and success/failure rates
finding: Analytics returns database results or an error, never sample figures after database failure.
